component.name: PkgScope
component.summary: Inspect packages and binaries, and trace them in a sandbox

description.p: PkgScope unpacks and inspects Linux packages (deb, rpm, pacman, apk, xbps, Slackware, ipk), AppImages, Snaps, ELF binaries and install scripts without installing them. It builds a tree of what an installer would put where, flags suspicious maintainer scripts, setuid files, rootkit-style libraries and embedded network indicators, and verifies files against the package's own checksums.

It can also run the file inside an isolated, no-root sandbox (user, mount, PID and network namespaces with a copy-on-write overlay and a seccomp filter) and record exactly what it does: the process tree, every file it creates or modifies, and every host it tries to contact. The sandbox never touches your real system, and everything is cleaned up afterwards.
Reports export to HTML, JSON and Markdown. A command-line front-end (pkgscope-cli) is available for scripting and CI.
